The authoritative status is that the Teams integration is **not done**. It is in **active design and planning**, with a release target of **Q4 2026 (v2.11.0, November release)** [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. The Slack thread is explicitly labeled as informal, low-authority internal discussion that does not constitute official product documentation, and directs readers to the Product Roadmap (NL-014) for official timelines [NL-027#NL-027-S01]. The claims in the Slack thread that it is "basically done" or "right around the corner" come from a salesperson (Marcus) and are explicitly rejected by the CTO (Leon), who states the official roadmap has it slated for design in Q4 2026, and that engineering is "[not] actively writing code for it" [NL-027#NL-027-S02]. The engineers further clarify that the demo shown at the sales kickoff was a "toy" with zero tenant isolation, zero permission mapping, zero SSO, and zero formatting, and would be a "security nightmare" in production [NL-027#NL-027-S03]. Product (Sofia) confirms the integration is in design for Q4 and states they do not release insecure 'alpha' features [NL-027#NL-027-S04]. Additionally, a call record with a customer shows a direct sales overclaim, which the evidence explicitly notes is contradicted by the official roadmap showing it is "in design / planned for Q4 2026" and not generally available [NL-023#NL-023-S04]. The engineering debate further confirms that Teams integration must stay in the design phase for Q4, with development slated for early 2027, and cannot be prioritized over the OCR pipeline [NL-015#NL-015-S06].
